# assets_audio_player

**Tag**: web, mobile, desktop, networking

## 简介

Play music/audio stored in assets files directly from Flutter & Network, Radio, LiveStream, Local files. Compatible with Android, iOS, web and macOS.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/florent37/Flutter-AssetsAudioPlayer
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/assets_audio_player
